verdict.rationale: Insomnia's own docs say environments define groups of variables (such as base URLs, tokens and credentials) that apply across requests. They can be scoped globally, per collection, or per folder, and plans include unlimited environments, which covers maintaining dev, staging and prod variable sets. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the mechanism for switching the active environment on a request, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can switch requests between dev, staging, and prod using environment variable sets

citations.quote: Use environments to define groups of variables that Insomnia applies across your requests. For example, you could create variables for base URLs, tokens, or credentials.
Global environments, which can be accessed by all collections in a project
